## Description

Brief description of changes.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation update

Closes #(issue number)

## Testing

- [ ] All existing tests pass (`python -m pytest tests/`)
- [ ] New tests added for changes
- [ ] Manual verification performed

## Checklist

- [ ] Code follows project style guidelines
- [ ] Type hints added for new public APIs
- [ ] Docstrings updated for new/modified functions
- [ ] Documentation updated (README, BUILD_GUIDE.md if applicable)
- [ ] No secrets or credentials in changes
- [ ] No large generated artifacts committed
- [ ] No dataset files committed

Any additional information for reviewers.
